## The question

[What latex class/template is used for documentation by SageMath?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/734959/what-latex-class-template-is-used-for-documentation-by-sagemath), asked by [Schroedinger'sDog](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/214205/schroedingersdog) on TeX Stack Exchange (2025-01-13; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)):

> I am preparing documentation for a code package and I prefer the [documentation style used by SageMath][q-1]. It also seems to used in a few other places such as [here][q-2]. Is a LaTex template for the SageMath documentation available anywhere? (I could reverse engineer the template using the ```memoir``` class, but perhaps it might save me some valuable time by asking kind strangers for help first.)
>
>
>   [q-1]: https://doc.sagemath.org/pdf/en/a_tour_of_sage/a_tour_of_sage.pdf
>   [q-2]: https://mosullivan.sdsu.edu/Teaching/sdsu-sage-tutorial/SDSUSageTutorial.pdf
:::

From [LaTeX customization](https://www.sphinx-doc.org/en/master/latex.html) on the Sphinx documentation site:

> The LaTeX package file `sphinx.sty` loads various components providing support macros (aka commands), and environments, which are used in the mark-up produced on output from the latex builder, before conversion to pdf via the LaTeX toolchain. Also the  LaTeX class files `sphinxhowto.cls` and `sphinxmanual.cls` define or customize some environments. All of these files can be found in the latex build repertory.

So you really only need those three files in addition to an adequate TeX distribution. I found them in the [sphinx source repo](https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/tree/master/sphinx/texinputs). Then this template worked for me:

```latex
\def\sphinxdocclass{report}
\documentclass[letterpaper,10pt,english]{sphinxmanual}
\usepackage{times}
\usepackage[Bjarne]{fncychap}
\usepackage{sphinx}


\usepackage{lipsum}% just for placeholder text

\title{Lorem Ipsum}
\author{R.J.~Drofnats}
\newcommand{\sphinxlogo}{}

\begin{document}

\maketitle
\tableofcontents

\chapter{Foo}
\lipsum 
\chapter{Bar}
\lipsum
\end{document}
```
